title: Small Business Electricity Supply Billing Parameters: State Sales Tax Rates, Rounding and Correction Limits
content:
Billing operations apply the following parameters to every Small Business Electricity Supply plan. All six plans (Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable, Fixed 12, Fixed 24, Fixed 36, Green 24 and Green 36) carry identical values.

## State sales tax rates on commercial supply charges

| Service state | Sales tax rate Beacon Ridge collects |
|---|---|
| Pennsylvania (PA) | 6.000 percent |
| New Jersey (NJ) | 6.625 percent |
| Maryland (MD) | 6.000 percent |
| Ohio (OH) | 0.000 percent (electricity not subject to sales tax) |
| Illinois (IL) | 0.000 percent (electricity not subject to sales tax) |

## Other billing parameters

| Parameter | Value on every plan |
|---|---|
| Rounding applied to every computed charge, tax and credit | half up to the cent |
| Calendar months after posting during which a billed line may be corrected | 12 months |
| Largest rebill credit a care agent may post on one line | 250.00 USD |
| Billing cycle from which a sales tax exemption takes effect | cycles beginning on or after the tax exemption date |
| Sales tax billed before an exemption took effect refunded by Beacon Ridge | no |

## Rounding half up to the cent, illustrated

Each computed amount is rounded to two decimals, a third decimal of 5 or more rounding the cent up. Hypothetical figures:

| Unrounded amount | Rounded |
|---|---|
| 41.2349 USD | 41.23 USD |
| 41.2350 USD | 41.24 USD |
| 7.8649 USD | 7.86 USD |

## Sales tax rate, illustrated

Hypothetical taxable amount of 300.00 USD for one cycle: at the New Jersey rate of 6.625 percent the tax is 300.00 multiplied by 6.625 and divided by 100, which is 19.875 USD, rounded half up to 19.88 USD; at the Pennsylvania or Maryland rate of 6.000 percent it is 18.00 USD; in Ohio or Illinois the rate is 0.000 percent.
